text_description: A coordinated light aqua-blue, heavily sparkling denim-style look worn in a relaxed, oversized silhouette: an open long-sleeve shirt jacket with a pointed collar, dropped shoulders, wide body, and hip-length hem layered over a white fitted camisole or bodysuit, with black bra straps and a black lace bra panel visibly showing through/around the deep open neckline. The jacket has allover sequined or glittering surface texture, mottled blue wash variation, frayed-looking edges along the placket, collar, hem, cuffs, and pocket seams, two chest flap pockets with gold-tone button closures, and additional gold-tone buttons down the front. Below, matching light blue sparkling pants sit at the waist under a black belt or waistband, continuing the same shimmery washed texture in a straight, relaxed cut visible to mid-leg. Styling includes chunky gold earrings and a small beige quilted clutch held at the side, adding a soft neutral accent against the icy blue shine. The overall mood is casual-luxe and slightly undone, mixing denim workwear proportions with high-sparkle embellishment and exposed lingerie layering.
